mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NL_INPUT_HISTORY ( HISTORY_ID, USER_ID, TYPE, INPUT_TEXT, USE_COUNT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( nextval('SEQ_NL_INPUT_HISTORY'), #{userId}, #{type}, #{inputText}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, TYPE, INPUT_TEXT) DO UPDATE SET USE_COUNT = NL_INPUT_HISTORY.USE_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
